newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebecor Printing sees profit at AmerSig.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor Printing sees profit at AmerSig.

text.p: Quebecor Printing Inc said on Monday its AmerSig catalogue printing unit is expected to produce "normal" profit margins in 12 to 18 months.
U.S.-based AmerSig Graphics Inc was losing money before interest costs when it was acquired by Quebecor Printing in 1995. AmerSig has four plants and 1,500 employees.

"By improving efficiency in the plants, we plan on delivering normal margins in 12 to 18 months in AmerSig," Quebecor Printing chief operating officer Charles Cavell told the company's annual meeting.
Cavell said he expected Quebecor Printing's global catalogue sales to increase to about US$550 million by the end of 1997. The company had catalogue printing sales of US$407 million in 1996.
